verdict.rationale: Stripe Checkout/Elements documentation confirms 125+ local payment methods and localized payment links, which covers digital wallets, bank redirects, and local methods from one integration; however, the evidence never explicitly names Apple Pay, Google Pay, or specific BNPL providers, and there's no independent/hands-on confirmation of the exact method mix. missing for 10: explicit mention of Apple Pay/Google Pay support, named BNPL providers (e.g., Klarna/Afterpay), and independent verification of the full payment-method list.
